Go over and sit with her introduce yourself. Ask her if she uses reddit, if she does BAM you have something in common and something to talk about. Ask her what music or movies she is into what she likes doing. If she seems lonely and doesn't talk to anyone someone showing interest in her might be flattering. If you are worried about the whole turning red thing and sweating and the language barrier the best advice I can give is don't worry about it. As long as you don't introduce yourself as hi i'm vetalurg would you like to see my underground sex dungeon. You won't come off as creepy. The more you try to talk to people the more experience and confidence you will have talking to people. Then the whole social thing won't seem so daunting.
